title: Machine Learning Projects
summary: A student repository of machine learning coursework and assignments spanning regression, classification, and a wildfire-prediction project. One notebook, Code_to_create_a_Self_Generating_Dataset.ipynb, generates a synthetic dataset and calls SDV's evaluation API (evaluate_quality, get_column_plot, get_column_pair_plot) to assess and visualize how well the synthetic data matches the real data.
evidence: Assignment 1/Code_to_create_a_Self_Generating_Dataset.ipynb:1109-1188 imports evaluate_quality, get_column_plot, get_column_pair_plot from sdv.evaluation.single_table and calls them on real_data/synthetic_data
